findings.title: v3 upgrade/reinstall drops customer columns that use eql_v3 domains
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The new v3 upgrade/install path re-runs a bundle starting with DROP SCHEMA eql_v3 CASCADE, where the column domains live, so dependent customer columns would be dropped; v2 avoids this via a public type created only if absent.

findings.title: Supabase v3 filters put decryptable ciphertext and all index terms into request URLs
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same verified full-envelope-in-URL mechanism in query-builder-v3 encryptCollectedTerms; the change introduces it.

findings.title: Encrypted like/ilike on default-configured v3 text columns silently returns no rows
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The default include_original:true plus the cs remap with a full-envelope operand means default TextSearch like/ilike silently miss substring matches, as the code comment and docs acknowledge.

findings.title: wasm-inline client accepts v3 schemas but emits v2-wire envelopes
findings.label: valid
findings.note: wasm-inline Encryption() calls wasmNewClient without eqlVersion or the mixed-schema guard while the change widens getColumnName to accept v3 columns, so v3 use on edge runtimes would get the FFI's v2 default wire format.

findings.title: protect-ffi 0.27 bump changes v2 behaviour for existing users
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculation that protect-ffi 0.27 changes v2 output; no cited code shows a v2 wire change and eqlVersion stays undefined for v2.
